name: Agreement
definition: Contractual details related to an agreement between parties.

DateSigned.name: Date Signed
DateSigned.definition: Date on which the agreement was signed by all parties.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Full name of an agreement, annexes and amendments in place between the principals.

Version.name: Version
Version.definition: Version number of a contract or of a  legal agreement.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Period during which the agreement is valid

Trade.name: Trade
Trade.definition: Specifies the type of trade that is the subject of an agreement. The agreement contains the clauses that will govern each trade between the signing parties.
